title: Ask the Experts: Inside Nemotron Post-Training | Nemotron Labs
summary: NVIDIA researchers are hosting a Nemotron Labs session explaining how they produced the final Nemotron model checkpoints through post-training, with a focus on improving intelligence and agentic behavior. The session walks through their pipeline using NeMo Data Designer for task-specific synthetic datasets, NeMo Gym for training environments, and NeMo RL for reinforcement learning, while pointing researchers to open Hugging Face datasets plus Nemotron GitHub recipes and weights they can reuse.

extra.full_text: In this Ask the Experts session, NVIDIA AI researchers explain how they built the final Nemotron model checkpoints through post-training to enhance model intelligence and enable agentic capabilities. They’ll walk through the tools they used, how they structured the data pipeline, and the open resources available for the community to build on. Learn how NeMo Data Designer was used to create task-specific synthetic datasets, NeMo Gym to build and manage training environments, and NeMo RL for reinforcement learning training. Learn about the post-training datasets published on HuggingFace and the recipes and weights on the Nemotron GitHub that are available under open licenses. What you'll learn: Different stages of post-training pipeline that goes into building SOTA models How NVIDIA NeMo libraries was used to implement and run post-training workflows Which datasets, recipes, and model weights are openly available, and where to find them How to start using NeMo Data Designer, NeMo Gym, and NeMo RL in your own post-training workflows Bring your questions about the Nemotron model training pipeline, NVIDIA’s open post-training tools, or how to get started. The researchers behind Nemotron 3 will answer them live.
